dedupe_keys.name: canada1water bathymetric digital terrain model macrotiles

description: The Canada1Water digital terrain model combines elevation and lake bathymetry across continental Canada and connected transboundary watersheds with the United States. The producer combined NASADEM-derived elevations, higher-resolution Arctic sources and open lake bathymetry for lakes at least ten square kilometres, then harmonised the datum, filled voids and corrected canopy effects. The Data in Brief article describes stacked GeoTIFF bands for surface, bare-earth elevation and bathymetric terrain at one arcsecond, roughly twenty metres across much of Canada. The current Zenodo release lists sixty-one files, including ten-by-ten-degree macrotiles, under CC BY 4.0. This is a terrain surface for hydrologic modelling, not a time series of measured flows or a map of every small lake bottom. Source DEM differences, lake-size cutoff and resampling are limitations at local engineering scale. A reviewer-assessed use is terrain forcing for national integrated water simulations. data-usgs-3d-elevation-program is a related elevation resource across the border; direct tile alignment was not tested. No large raster was downloaded.
